title: Session-span compactification and approximate cost signatures for console
author: Lila Chen
description:
Motivation: Our long-tail trace volume and raw span cardinality are significant cost drivers for the telemetry pipeline (especially for sessionized requests with many tiny internal spans). This PR introduces a compactification transformation that condenses dense, short-lived spans within a single session into a single condensed span (with counts/aggregates) and attaches an approximate cost signature computed from model metadata and token histograms. The goal is to preserve actionable observability (latency/cost attribution, outlier detection) while reducing storage/ingest overhead and improving dashboard readability.

Summary of changes: 1) tracing/ingest: add span-compactifier transform to the trace pipeline that merges adjacent spans in the same session if they meet duration/token thresholds; the compactified span includes aggregated duration, total token delta, and an "approx_cost_sig" field (a compact base64-encoded signature representing model family, quantization tier, and a 3-bucket token histogram). 2) runtime instrumentation: lightweight counters to emit per-session small-span counts and token deltas to enable validation and rollbacks. 3) console: new "Session Compact View" panel available in trace view and the cost explorer which shows condensed spans and exposes a link to expand to raw spans for the past 24h. 4) alerting: small adjustments to long-tail SLO alerts to account for compactified span rollups and a supplemental rule to fire on the underlying raw-span error rate to avoid masking failures. 5) migration/opt-in: feature gate (telemetry.compactification.enabled) default-off for private deployments; hosted rollout via gradual flag to 20% of traces first.

Testing and validation: unit tests for the compactifier logic (edge cases for nested spans, overlapping sessions), integration harness with synthetic session workloads, and a short canary on staging receiving ~2k rps for 24h. Performance measurements on staging: ingest bytes reduced by ~15% for instrumented workloads, downstream IndexedSpan storage reduced by ~8%, and no measurable increase in per-request latency (added microsecond-level CPU on ingest path).

Rollout plan: (1) merge behind feature flag, (2) enable for 5% of hosted traces for 48h, monitor error rates and alert fidelity, (3) expand to 20% if stable, (4) enable by default after 2 weeks and documentation updates. Rollback: disable feature flag or revert ingestion config; condensed spans are only produced at ingestion time and raw spans are retained for 24h in case we need to rehydrate.

Related work and references: ENG-3214 (session telemetry cost reduction), ENG-3220 (console UX for condensed traces), internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3214/session-compactification-design.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test in trace harness - [x] Console panel styled and covered by simple snapshot tests - [x] Performance measurements recorded - [x] Rollout gating implemented

review_comments: Asha Varma: Overall looks solid. Two concerns: ensure compacted spans keep enough context for downstream SLO attribution; add a test for nested spans where inner spans should not be merged across parent boundaries.

Lila Chen (author): Added nested-span test and updated compactifier to check parent boundaries (see commit e4b3a55). For context retention we include original session_id, sample_raw_link, and aggregated histogram in the compactified span.
Diego Marquez: Can we make the approx_cost_sig format extensible? Suggest including a version byte so future signatures can be decoded safely.
Lila Chen (author): Switched signature to versioned binary (v1) and documented format in docs/observability/session-compactification.md.
Connor Blake: CI initially failed on a flaky e2e:trace harness test. Reran and it passed. Please monitor the staging canary for the next 48h before increasing rollout.
Lila Chen (author): noted; canary monitoring dashboard added and alerts wired up.
release_notes: Introduce session-span compactification to reduce telemetry ingest and storage costs; add approximate cost signatures for condensed spans; new Session Compact View in Console; feature-gated rollout and raw-span retention for 24h.
notes: Feature is behind a gate for private deployments; hosted rollout will be gradual. Teams owning alerts should review the 'long_tail_slo_adjustments.yaml' to avoid false positives during the ramp.
